payload.text: Reading prez's acceptance runs: AT01 asserts the in-crate target, so a run with CARGO_TARGET_DIR redirected reads AT01 red by construction; acceptance.sh:248 builds the tree it runs in, so a red on main runs the new suite in main's own tree; and AT20's window can read 0 wide under load, so re-run AT20 alone before calling it red.
